title: UISD Police Security Guard Sanjuana Rodriguez Gives Thanks for Her Family's Health This Thanksgiving
excerpt: Sanjuana Rodriguez, a security guard with the United Independent School District Police Department, says she is thankful this Thanksgiving season that her family is in good health, and the district thanked her for her commitment to keeping the United ISD family safe.
content:
Sanjuana Rodriguez, a security guard with the United Independent School District Police Department, says she is thankful this Thanksgiving season that her family is in good health.

“I'm thankful that my family is in good health,” Rodriguez said in a message the district shared on Friday, Nov. 27, 2026.

United ISD thanked Rodriguez for her commitment to keeping the United ISD family safe.
